title: Nether Portal Rework
description: Makes Crying obsidian required to light a portal.
body:
## At least 1 Crying Obsidian is now required to light a nether portal.

![crying obsidian required](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0eebce41a1d3fbcc5b67234146ab5d73129e88e.png)

## Crying Obsidian Now drops Regular Obdsidian when mined.


The goal of this mod is to incentivize players to explore and repair ruined Portals without making custom portal creation impossible in mid to late game.
